criteria.name: archetype_and_method
criteria.criterion: Archetype named and primary method justified
criteria.detail: PASS: Archetype (software_saas) is explicitly named with justification (SIC code, intangibles-heavy balance sheet), and the primary method (multi-stage FCF DCF) is stated and justified as archetype-appropriate ("not a bank/REIT/insurer — FCF DCF is structurally valid here"), with comps used as a secondary cross-check.

criteria.name: evidence_for_argued_inputs
criteria.criterion: Every argued input cites ≥1 resolvable evidence field
criteria.detail: 10 argued input(s) each have ≥1 resolvable evidence field (resolver=10, engine_record=0)

criteria.name: no_untraceable_currency
criteria.criterion: No currency figure appears that is not traceable to an engine block
criteria.detail: 92 currency figure(s) traceable to engine blocks

criteria.name: terminal_value_share_stated
criteria.criterion: Terminal-value share of EV stated (DCF path)
criteria.detail: terminal-value share language found in valuation text

criteria.name: valuation_as_range
criteria.criterion: Valuation expressed as a range, not a point
criteria.detail: range language detected in valuation text

criteria.name: comparison_windows_consistent
criteria.criterion: Comparison windows consistent and stated (no YTD vs 1-yr mixing)

criteria.name: unresolved_risk
criteria.criterion: ≥1 risk left explicitly unresolved (no self-neutralizing close)
criteria.detail: PASS: The memo explicitly leaves multiple risks unresolved and unquantified rather than neutralizing them — e.g., the SBC-adjustment gap is stated as "the top diligence item" the desk "cannot quantify," the WACC not being "re-underwritten for the post-recap capital structure" is flagged as unresolved, and the $30.3B net debt increase is disclosed as a value deduction investors must "mentally" apply, not one the model resolves.

criteria.name: default_and_judgment_cases
criteria.criterion: Both default and judgment cases present

criteria.name: no_numeric_contradiction
criteria.criterion: No internal numeric contradiction (same metric, two values)
criteria.detail: contradictions: g_high: [0.688, 0.26] (not explained by argued shape: default/central/corners/sensitivities)
